purpose: This table provides one cleaned record per aircraft tail number, describing its manufacturer, model, type, engine configuration, and physical characteristics for downstream analytics that join flight events to aircraft attributes.
usage: Join on tailnum to enrich flight-level fact tables with aircraft metadata; consumers should expect year and speed to contain nulls and should handle them explicitly rather than assume every aircraft has a manufacture year or recorded speed.
limitations: speed is populated for only about 0.7% of rows (null_rate 0.993076) so it is unreliable for broad analysis; year is missing for about 2.1% of rows (null_rate 0.021072); manufacturer and model remain free-text strings with no standardization applied in this pass.
